up: Retrieve every activity record associated with the assay that has ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1614414. For each record, output the standard activity type (standard_type), the standard relation (standard_relation), the standard numeric value (standard_value), the standard units (standard_units), the canonical SMILES of the tested compound (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles), and the ChEMBL identifier of the molecule (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id). Join the activities table to assays on activity.assay_id = assays.assay_id, to compound_structures on activity.molregno = compound_structures.molregno, and to molecule_dictionary on activity.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno. Do not apply any filters beyond the assay identifier; include all results without limiting the number of rows.
sql: SELECT a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614414' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
